Marine megafauna and tuna fisheries

Assessing vulnerability across the Indian Ocean

Explore the work

ProjectsResearchExpeditionsDiscuss a project

I coauthored a spatially explicit risk assessment of marine megafauna vulnerability to Indian Ocean tuna fisheries, published in Fish and Fisheries in 2022.

Status: published, 2022.

Journal: Fish and Fisheries.

My role: coauthor.

The study

The research examines marine megafauna vulnerability in relation to tuna fisheries across the Indian Ocean, with an explicitly spatial approach to risk assessment.

Publication

Roberson, L. A., et al. (2022). Spatially explicit risk assessment of marine megafauna vulnerability to Indian Ocean tuna fisheries. Fish and Fisheries.
